zh:
# Endless Sky

探索其他恒星系。通过贸易、运送乘客或完成任务赚钱。用收入购买更好的飞船，或升级现有飞船的武器和引擎。炸毁海盗船。选择支持内战中的一方。或者离开人类空间，希望找到文化比你自己的文明更发达的友好外星人……

------

Endless Sky 是一款沙盒式太空探索游戏，类似 Elite、Escape Velocity 或 Star Control。你以一艘小型宇宙飞船的船长身份开始游戏，之后可以自行选择要做什么。游戏包含一条主要剧情线和许多支线任务，但你可以选择推进剧情，或独自成为商人、赏金猎人或探险家。

更多信息请参阅[玩家手册](https://github.com/endless-sky/endless-sky/wiki/PlayersManual)，也可在[主页](https://endless-sky.github.io/)查看截图和偶尔发布的博客文章。

## 安装游戏

Endless Sky 的官方发行版可从 [GitHub](https://github.com/endless-sky/endless-sky/releases/latest) 直接下载，也可通过 [Steam](https://store.steampowered.com/app/404410/Endless_Sky/)、[GOG](https://gog.com/game/endless_sky) 和 [Flathub](https://flathub.org/apps/details/io.github.endless_sky.endless_sky) 获取。其他包管理器中也可能包含本游戏，但提供的版本可能不是最新版本。

## 系统要求

Endless Sky 的系统要求很低，大多数系统应该都能够运行。最严格的要求可能是设备至少支持 OpenGL 3。

| 硬件 | 最低 | 推荐 |
|---|----:|----:|
| 内存 | 750 MB | 2 GB |
| 显卡 | OpenGL 2.0* | OpenGL 3.0 |
| 屏幕分辨率 | 1024x768 | 1920x1080 |
| 可用存储空间 | 400 MB | 1.5 GB |

\* OpenGL 2 设备需要[自定义着色器](https://github.com/endless-sky/endless-sky/wiki/CreatingPlugins#shaders)。

| 操作系统 | 最低版本 |
|---|---|
| Linux | 任何现代发行版（相当于 Ubuntu 20.04） |
| MacOS | 10.15 |
| Windows | XP（5.1） |

Endless Sky 可能也可以在其他操作系统上运行，但官方不提供支持。

## 从源代码构建

开发时使用 [CMake](https://cmake.org) 编译项目。通过各自的 CMake 集成，支持大多数流行的 IDE。

完整安装说明请参阅[构建说明](https://github.com/endless-sky/endless-sky/blob/d943c9e5ed07f1edff8951365fc9d095ab3a2c03/docs/readme-developer.md)。

## 参与贡献

作为一款免费开源游戏，Endless Sky 是许多人共同努力的成果。美术作品、故事情节和其他文字内容的贡献最受需要，项目也有一份大致定义的[路线图](https://github.com/endless-sky/endless-sky/wiki/DevelopmentRoadmap)。希望[贡献](https://github.com/endless-sky/endless-sky/blob/d943c9e5ed07f1edff8951365fc9d095ab3a2c03/docs/CONTRIBUTING.md)的人，建议先查看 [Wiki](https://github.com/endless-sky/endless-sky/wiki)，并先在[社区运营的 Discord](https://discord.gg/ZeuASSx) 发帖。偏好 Steam 的用户也可以使用其[讨论区](https://steamcommunity.com/app/404410/discussions/)，或 GitHub 的[讨论区](https://github.com/endless-sky/endless-sky/discussions)。

Endless Sky 的主要讨论和开发区域曾是 [Google Groups](https://groups.google.com/g/endless-sky)，但由于我们无法控制的因素，新用户现已无法访问，因此不应再使用。

## 许可

Endless Sky 是免费开源游戏。[源代码](https://github.com/endless-sky/endless-sky/)采用 GPL v3 许可；所有美术作品要么属于公共领域，要么采用多种知识共享及类似的宽松许可证发布。（要确定某项美术作品的版权状态，请查阅[版权文件](https://github.com/endless-sky/endless-sky/blob/d943c9e5ed07f1edff8951365fc9d095ab3a2c03/copyright)。）
en:
# Endless Sky

Explore other star systems. Earn money by trading, carrying passengers, or completing missions. Use your earnings to buy a better ship or to upgrade the weapons and engines on your current one. Blow up pirates. Take sides in a civil war. Or leave human space behind and hope to find some friendly aliens whose culture is more civilized than your own...

------

Endless Sky is a sandbox-style space exploration game similar to Elite, Escape Velocity, or Star Control. You start out as the captain of a tiny spaceship and can choose what to do from there. The game includes a major plot line and many minor missions, but you can choose whether you want to play through the plot or strike out on your own as a merchant or bounty hunter or explorer.

See the [player's manual](https://github.com/endless-sky/endless-sky/wiki/PlayersManual) for more information, or the [home page](https://endless-sky.github.io/) for screenshots and the occasional blog post.

## Installing the game

Official releases of Endless Sky are available as direct downloads from [GitHub](https://github.com/endless-sky/endless-sky/releases/latest), on [Steam](https://store.steampowered.com/app/404410/Endless_Sky/), on [GOG](https://gog.com/game/endless_sky), and on [Flathub](https://flathub.org/apps/details/io.github.endless_sky.endless_sky). Other package managers may also include the game, though the specific version provided may not be up-to-date.

## System Requirements

Endless Sky has very minimal system requirements, meaning most systems should be able to run the game. The most restrictive requirement is likely that your device must support at least OpenGL 3.

|Hardware | Minimum | Recommended |
|---|----:|----:|
|RAM | 750 MB | 2 GB |
|Graphics | OpenGL 2.0* | OpenGL 3.0 |
|Screen Resolution | 1024x768 | 1920x1080 |
|Storage Free | 400 MB | 1.5 GB |

\* For OpenGL 2 devices, [custom shaders](https://github.com/endless-sky/endless-sky/wiki/CreatingPlugins#shaders) are needed.

|Operating System | Minimum Version |
|---|---|
|Linux | Any modern distribution (equivalent of Ubuntu 20.04) |
|MacOS | 10.15 |
|Windows | XP (5.1) |

It may be possible to run Endless Sky on other operating systems, though it is not officially supported.

## Building from source

Development is done using [CMake](https://cmake.org) to compile the project. Most popular IDEs are supported through their respective CMake integration.

For full installation instructions, consult the [Build Instructions](https://github.com/endless-sky/endless-sky/blob/d943c9e5ed07f1edff8951365fc9d095ab3a2c03/docs/readme-developer.md) readme.

## Contributing

As a free and open source game, Endless Sky is the product of many people's work. Contributions of artwork, storylines, and other writing are most in-demand, though there is a loosely defined [roadmap](https://github.com/endless-sky/endless-sky/wiki/DevelopmentRoadmap). Those who wish to [contribute](https://github.com/endless-sky/endless-sky/blob/d943c9e5ed07f1edff8951365fc9d095ab3a2c03/docs/CONTRIBUTING.md) are encouraged to review the [wiki](https://github.com/endless-sky/endless-sky/wiki), and to post in the [community-run Discord](https://discord.gg/ZeuASSx) beforehand. Those who prefer to use Steam can use its [discussion rooms](https://steamcommunity.com/app/404410/discussions/) as well, or GitHub's [discussion zone](https://github.com/endless-sky/endless-sky/discussions).

Endless Sky's main discussion and development area was once [Google Groups](https://groups.google.com/g/endless-sky), but due to factors outside our control, it is now inaccessible to new users, and should not be used anymore.

## Licensing

Endless Sky is a free, open source game. The [source code](https://github.com/endless-sky/endless-sky/) is available under the GPL v3 license, and all the artwork is either public domain or released under a variety of Creative Commons (and similarly permissive) licenses. (To determine the copyright status of any of the artwork, consult the [copyright file](https://github.com/endless-sky/endless-sky/blob/d943c9e5ed07f1edff8951365fc9d095ab3a2c03/copyright).)
